title: CNF encoding of a transition gate
statement: For a finite Turing machine $M$, natural numbers $n,s,p,h,v$, and a machine case $q$, form the CNF gate encoding of the Boolean predicate on port assignments that accepts when the transition-kind predicate is true. Read each gate-input bit from the assignment at the wire corresponding to that port, and connect each port to its assigned wire.
